quests.title: Tell Thorga What Moves a Ramp
quests.text: The front needs food and sound gear as much as another load of beams. Go to Thorga Roadspeaker in Gor Drazhak; she has work getting those supplies ready. Tell her Drek can hold a ramp together if the people carrying it have something in their bellies.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only): a departure to a giver with work at once.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft DR1: the free departure to Thorga at 42 (her work at 42, 44 and 45).

quests.title: Payment in Full
quests.text: My crews dig up grave coin with a fresh broken circle burned through it, and Toll-Taker Senn keeps finding more dead to pay. Kill four Aqueduct Bowmen or Coal-Purse Factors in all at the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, where they guard his money day and night, and kill Senn. Turn out his branded toll-box at {name:r20_anchor_078}; I want the name of whoever pays a man to make my road impassable.
quests.completion: Chirr paid Senn to keep the crossing deadly, and Senn sent the tolls back for another burning; the dead earned them money in both directions. Those Accord requisitions may name a supplier, but I cannot tell what the entries do to the dead they list. Orrel Hollowstep can read that part, and I have a coin for him to examine.

quests.title: A Coin for Orrel
quests.text: Senn paid the dead to keep them on the road, then sent the tolls back to the soot factors for another burning; a remittance from Paymaster Chirr in The Skyglass Canopy promises fresh payments for every crossing kept deadly. Apparently a corpse earns better than a bridge. I know mud, not the dead, so take one of those coins to Orrel Hollowstep at Hollowarch Station in Blackwind Rise. He'll complain about the fingerprints, but he'll read it.
quests.completion: Drek has found a business that pays better when the road kills its customers. This burn is new to me, and I will not name it until I have seen what it covers. I will have you wash the ash from the old names at the {name:kragmar_blackwind_rise/ashen_grave}; then we can tell the Warmaster what has been laid over them.

quests.title: Let That Banner Fall
quests.text: Standard-Bearer Ninepins pledged his banner against the next payment, then the next, until every salute became another debt. Kill four Rubble Skeletons at night in the {name:front_shattered_line/breach} and defeat Ninepins, {dir_from_giver:standard_bearer_ninepins}. Report to the Warmaster: the pledge slips bear seals of The Accord, and I will not stitch our fallen into a pawnbroker's inventory.
quests.completion: Ninepins has fallen, and the pledge slips prove that fresh payments kept his command alive. They still do not tell us who set the money moving. I want the enemy captain's orders next; a Warmaster should know whose hand he is accusing.

quests.title: Room Under the Banner
quests.text: I can keep stitching this standard, but somebody has to give the Accord a reason to fear it. Go to {name:pvp_fortress_throng}, {dir_from_giver:pvp_fortress_throng}, and report to the Warmaster for the fight against their Battlegrounds camps. Tell the Warmaster I sent a fighter; I have no spare cloth for a letter.
quests.lesson: Entry: from a 31-40 outpost to the PvP fortress at level 40.

quests.title: Nobody Sings About Bolts
quests.text: Every loudmouth in this hold promises to be our shield, yet the Quartermaster still has to mend the gate. Bring me four Silversteel Bars for gate bolts and arrowheads. There is honour in keeping a warband armed, even if nobody sings about the bolts.
quests.lesson: Fortress supplies: an ordinary tier-4 bar.

quests.title: Something Solid to Boast About
quests.text: My recruits swear they could beat the Accord with one hand, usually while dropping their weapons with the other. Bring me six War Trophies from Accord soldiers you defeat; any Accord garrison or guard post will serve. I want something from a real fight to hang in the drill yard before another practice dummy hears a victory speech.
quests.lesson: War Trophies drop only from enemy guards killed by a player (never a player kill).

quests.title: No Toll for the Throng
quests.text: Causeway Brigands keep stopping my scouts to ask what their lives are worth. Kill five of those brigands by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}. We have Accord camps to watch, and I will not have our riders held up haggling with thieves.
quests.lesson: Scouting a Battlegrounds zone: a kill quest on its 41-43 kind.

quests.title: Rattle the Picket Line
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_low}, watches our movements like a cook watching the last joint of meat. Kill four Accord Pickets and {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_low} at that camp. Give them a fight to handle while my riders get on with their work.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Every Muddy Step
quests.text: Now the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_low}, is making our scouts earn every muddy step. Defeat four Accord Pickets and {captain:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_low}, who commands them. The marsh already takes a toll on our boots; the Accord does not get to take one on our riders.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Marching in Their Sleep
quests.text: The soldiers at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, have drilled until they can probably march in their sleep. Defeat five Accord Regulars and {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high} at that camp. Keep your feet when they hit back; a fighter who stumbles is just a future warning.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Shake the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_high}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_high}, keeps the Accord's war machine marching through all that mud. Kill five Accord Regulars and {captain:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_accord_high}, who commands the camp. They have discipline; show them one Throng fighter can stand firm too.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Lean on the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_low}
quests.text: My riders have enough trouble finding safe ground among the salt and old graves without the Accord measuring them for more. Strike the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_low}, and kill four Accord Skirmishers and {captain:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_low} there. I need a way through for the scouts, and I need you back to tell them it is open.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Let Them Hear Us Coming
quests.text: There is a great deal of forest to hide in, yet the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_low}, keeps spotting our scouts. Defeat four Accord Skirmishers and {captain:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_low} at that camp. Let them hear the Throng coming for once; my riders can use the distraction.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: A Steady Blade at Gravesalt
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_high}, holds fighters who have survived more than a few brave charges. Kill five Accord Veterans and {captain:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_accord_high} there. You owe the Throng a steady blade and a clear head; save the roaring for when you are back.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Greyvow Has Company
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high}, now has War Commander Greyvow fighting beside its garrison. Kill five Accord Veterans and {captain:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high} in that camp. The elite commander makes the raid harder, so bring help if you need it; your courage does not oblige me to replace you. Come back with the job done and enough breath to argue about it.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).
